exempt.no-bespoke-react-native-interactions: client/host-ui.tsx is the plugin-local composition that replaces the removed paseo-plugin-helper/client kit for slash (xpufx-org/paseo#937, #924). The host SDK ships no button/toggle/tab/select pressable primitive, so Button/Toggle/Tabs/Collapsible/Select compose Pressable over react-native. Every other helper/UI rule is followed; this is the single interaction seam.
